671-1339-1832-5231.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
671-1339-1832-5231.description:
Activate Unfulfilled Desires by paying {1} and 1 life, causing you to loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Insect, adding {R}
When the Insect dies, Daxos triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

245-2034-3000.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {6}, creating four creature tokens due to Chatterfang.
When the tokens enter, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat.

1594-2741-4399-4770.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Helm of Awakening.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Essence Warden trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Essence Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1594-2741-4399-4770.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1621-1739-2350-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

1283-2440-4183-7747.notablePrerequisites: Saheeli does not have summoning sickness.
1283-2440-4183-7747.description:
Activate Saheeli by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Giant-Sized Flying Ant with haste.
When the token Giant-Sized Flying Ant enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Giant-Sized Flying Ant trigger, untapping Saheeli.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with Giant-Sized Flying Ant.
Repeat.

141-2511-3125.notablePrerequisites: You have two creature cards in your graveyard.
141-2511-3125.description:
Cast Victimize by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Victimize.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Victimize
Resolve the Victimize copy, sacrificing a creature and returning Naru Meha and another creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

140-2063-3245.description:
Activate Mischievous Poltergeist by paying life.
Repeat step 1 as desired.
Activate Rowan by tapping it, reducing the cost of all black and/or red spells you cast this turn.
Cast Exsanguinate, choosing for X to equal the amount of life you've lost this turn, but paying a total of {B}{B} due to Rowan.
Resolve Exsanguinate, causing each opponent to lose X life, and you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.

2438-2730-5237.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Renegade Rallier.
When Renegade Rallier dies, Kaya's Ghostform triggers, returning Renegade Rallier from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Renegade Rallier enters, it triggers, returning Kaya's Ghostform from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Renegade Rallier
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1308-1409-5420.description:
Activate Plundering Pirate by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Plundering Pirate enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Plundering Pirate.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

967-3809-6441-6797-7087.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

2919-3490-4050-4716.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-4050-4716.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Prosperous Innkeeper triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

1778-2034-2173-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

339-677-1879-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

585-3000-4508-5880.description:
Activate Unnatural Selection by paying {1}, causing Magmaw to become a Pirate until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

277-1409-3875-6839.description:
Activate Ignis by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Ignis enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Ignis.
Resolve the Ignis trigger, causing you to look at the top six cards of your library and put a land card from among them onto the battlefield.
If you put a land onto the battlefield this way, Tireless Provisioner and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Treasure token. 
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land that entered
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Repeat.
277-1409-3875-6839.notes: This combo can fail if Ignis does not reveal a land. You can use additional mana to restart the combo if desired should this happen. The combo also assumes every land you grab will be mana-producing.

586-3375-5147-5258-5618.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2866-3446-4970-5751--49.description:
Cast Chromatic Sphere from your graveyard by paying {0} and discarding an artifact land card from your hand.
Activate Chromatic Sphere by paying {1}, tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1} and causing you to draw a card.
Scrap Trawler triggers, returning an artifact land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

598-2034-6429.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Razorlash Transmogrant from your graveyard by paying {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

372-695-864.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-695-864.description:
Cast Settle Beyond Reality by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Eternal Witness and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Eternal Witness trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Settle Beyond Reality from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Settle Beyond Reality.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Eternal Witness and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4050-4790-4891-5149.notablePrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Dino DNA.
4050-4790-4891-5149.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {4}, creating a token copy of Atsushi that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Atsushi token, adding {1}.
When the Atsushi token dies, it triggers, creating three Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate the three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1368-2196-3766.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
You control up to three lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1368-2196-3766.description:
Activate up to three lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Frantic Search for its escape cost by paying {2}{U} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard.
Dragon's Rage Channeler triggers, causing you to surveil 1, ensuring to put the top card of your library into your graveyard.
Resolve Frantic Search, causing you to loot twice and untap three lands.
Repeat.

578-1812-4222.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real attached to Metalworker.
Metalworker does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least two artifact cards in hand.
578-1812-4222.description:
Activate Metalworker by tapping it, causing you to reveal at least two artifact cards from your hand and add at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Metalworker.
Repeat.

719-997-4338.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Xenograft, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

451-3398.notablePrerequisites:
Hoard Hauler is a creature and does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Hoard Hauler or Hellkite Charger and controls at least seven artifacts.
451-3398.description:
Declare Hoard Hauler and Hellkite Charger as attackers, attacking an opponent who controls seven or more artifacts.
Hellkite Charger triggers, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using Hoard Hauler.
Hoard Hauler triggers, creating at least seven Treasure artifact tokens.
Move to your next combat phase.
Declare Hoard Hauler and Hellkite Charger as attackers, attacking an opponent who controls seven or more artifacts.
Hellkite Charger triggers, holding priority, activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {5}{R}{R}.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
If the opponent controls eight or more artifacts, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

549-1651-4024-4659.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Humans.
549-1651-4024-4659.description:
Activate Horn of Gondor by paying {3} and tapping it, creating at least three 1/1 Human Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping two Human Soldiers, untapping Horn of Gondor.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Human Soldiers, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

1170-1393-1482-2364.description:
Cast Mana Vault by paying {1}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Jeweled Lotus from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aether Channeler.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Mana Vault from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1131-2501-2539-2934.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature with power two or greater.
You have attacked this turn.
You have not cast an instant and/or sorcery spell this turn.
Your deck size is at least eleven.
1131-2501-2539-2934.description:
Cast Howl of the Horde by paying {2}{R} and sacrificing a creature with power two or greater.
Howl of the Horde's casualty ability triggers, creating two copies of it due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Howl of the Horde, causing you to copy the next instant or sorcery spell you cast six times.
Cast Prologue to Phyresis by paying {1}{U}.
Each Howl of the Horde triggers, copying Prologue to Phyresis a total of nine times due to Twinning Staff.
Resolve each Prologue to Phyresis, causing each opponent to get ten poison counters, and you to draw ten cards.
Each opponent loses the game due to having ten or more poison counters.

1251-1548-1550.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to Dragonlord Kolaghan.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Dragonlord Kolaghan and Port Razer.
1251-1548-1550.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent with Dragonlord Kolaghan and Port Razer, triggering Sword of Hearth and Home and Port Razer.
Resolve the Port Razer trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Sword of Hearth and Home trigger, exiling Port Razer, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Port Razer onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1367-1467-3634-4568.notablePrerequisites: You have not cast any instant or sorcery spell this turn.
1367-1467-3634-4568.description:
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxis triggers, creating a copy of Nexus of Fate.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
Venser enters the battlefield, returning itself and original Nexus of Fate to your hand.
Resolve the Nexus of Fate copy, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your extra turn.
Repeat.

539-618-2050.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Arbor Elf with haste.
Activate the Arbor Elf token by tapping it, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.

229-656-2034-2399.notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Endless One.
229-656-2034-2399.description:
Sacrifice Endless One to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant for {1}.
Sacrifice Ugin's Conjurant to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Endless One from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {1}.
Repeat.
